summary.usage: Dùng cho quyết định lúc nói, lời hứa hoặc dự đoán.
summary.example: I will help you carry those books.
summary.exampleVi: Tôi sẽ giúp bạn mang những quyển sách đó.

summary.tag: Cấu trúc nói về kế hoạch
summary.usage: Dùng cho kế hoạch đã định trước.
summary.example: We are going to visit Hue next month.
summary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi dự định thăm Huế tháng tới.

summary.tag: Từ nối và mối liên hệ giữa các ý
summary.formula: but = contrast / or = choice or warning / because = reason
summary.usage: Đọc quan hệ giữa hai ý trước khi chọn liên từ.
summary.example: We stayed indoors because the storm was strong.
summary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi ở trong nhà vì bão mạnh.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: "Those books look heavy." "I ___ help you carry them."
items.why: Quyết định giúp ngay lúc nói dùng will + V.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: We have bought the tickets. We ___ going to visit Hue next week.
items.why: We dùng are trong mẫu be going to + V; có kế hoạch trước.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: Lan ___ going to decorate the classroom tomorrow; she has already bought paper.
items.why: Lan số ít nên is going to; kế hoạch đã chuẩn bị.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: I promise I ___ return your book tomorrow.
items.why: Lời hứa dùng will + động từ nguyên mẫu return.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: We stayed indoors ___ the storm made the roads dangerous.
items.why: Vế sau giải thích lý do, dùng because.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: The puppy is small, ___ it can run very fast.
items.why: Hai ý trái với điều thường dự đoán, dùng but.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: Hurry up, ___ you will miss the school bus.
items.why: Or trong mệnh lệnh có nghĩa nếu không thì.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: Would you like water ___ milk? Please choose one.
items.why: Câu yêu cầu chọn một trong hai đồ uống, dùng or.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: What ___ the weather be like tomorrow?
items.why: Dạng câu hỏi tương lai: What will the weather be like?

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: We are going to ___ lanterns for the festival after lunch.
items.why: Sau going to dùng nguyên mẫu make.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: "I think the weather ___ be sunny tomorrow," says Mai.
items.why: Dự đoán có I think dùng will be.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.

items.title: Week 8 · Grammar
items.scene: Because the path was wet, we ___ carefully instead of running.
items.why: Quan hệ nguyên nhân cho thấy đi cẩn thận là hợp lý; ba từ còn lại đều đi nhanh.

source.adaptation: Centre-authored application of the linked weekly theory.
